note: Wooded campground on Indian Point two miles south of Silver Dollar City, with paved roads, boat parking at every site, a pool and cabins; Table Rock Lake marinas are nearby. --Claude
summary: Over $50 but Branson gateway (11 km) applies: ResNexus $60.76 (30A back-in, 33 ft max) to $77.34 (50A pull-through), same in January and May; full hookups 30/50A; showers/laundry/store/wifi/pool. Google 4.4/181. Waterfront lead: lakeview unearned - the sites sit ~300 m from Table Rock Lake behind a wooded ridge and Indian Point Road.
flags: WATERFRONT re-audit lead (stored lakeview -> not waterfront): on Esri imagery the campground lies east of Indian Point Road around 36.6334,-93.3445; the nearest water (a Table Rock Lake cove to the NW) is ~300 m from the closest pads, across the road and a continuous wooded slope, and condos stand between the campground and the lake to the north. The operator's 'Some locations offer lake views' is marketing and cannot carry the call. No sightline found, so down to not waterfront.

PRICE GATE: cheapest RV night $60.76 on ResNexus (30A back-in, 'Maximum Recommended Length is 33 ft'), on both 2027-01-12 and 2027-05-11 - over US$50, but gateways.py gives Branson (attraction) 11 km, so it passes under the gateway exception. The engine's figures look tax-inclusive ($60.76/$65.18/$77.34 equal $55/$59/$70 plus 10.47%), but no page says so, so tax is left unset. Presence: website with phone 417-338-5211 and online booking; Google Maps 4.4 over 181 reviews; RV Life 4* $$ (stored).

Sites: stored count 65 (from old note prose) not confirmed - ResNexus listed 25-30 RV sites open on the sampled nights and the operator states no total; left as stored. Monthly campers exist (policies: 'Monthly campers are responsible for mowing'), but the RV page says the sites 'are designed for short stays'; not a long-stay park.
Name: the operator now uses 'Lakeview Cabins & RV Campground' (site title and Google).
